notes.title: Demo updated (v1007)
notes.notes: [p]Hello![/p][p][/p][p]This update (v1007) was mostly to tweak how the overcrowding feature works.[/p][p][/p][p]The issue with the overcrowding was that it mostly appeared on the first biomes, but not on the later biomes.[/p][p][/p][p]The numbers also got tweaked (achievements/upgrades) so that the experience for the first-time player would be nicer.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Tweak so that overcrowding also works on the later biomes[/p][/*][*][p]Try to show mostly the "final" overcrowd number immediately, instead of increasing it every second[/p][/*][*][p]Make blobs look at the cake if the cake is on the screen[/p][/*][*][p]Move "nerf boss health" upgrade behind "+5 upgrade"[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly decrease +1 extra damage upgrade prices[/p][/*][*][p]Make early achievements easier to get[/p][/*][/list][p]- jounitus[/p]

notes.title: Demo updated (v1005)
notes.notes: [p]Hello![/p][p]The goal for this update (v1005) was to improve the experience at the very start of the game, so that most players wouldn't feel like getting "stuck" on the first biome.[/p][list][*][p]change the window title to Finger Party[/p][/*][*][p]lower the first biome's damage target[/p][/*][*][p]make the cake party event slightly more random[/p][/*][*][p]lower passive income upgrade price[/p][/*][*][p]limit "+1 damage" upgrade to three upgrades and lower the price slightly[/p][/*][*][p]tweak early achievements to be easier to get[/p][/*][*][p]lower "+5 extra damage" upgrade prices[/p][/*][*][p]add description/tip for "maximum level skip" upgrade[/p][/*][*][p]increase "restart button" upgrade price[/p][/*][*][p]increase "move mouse automatically" price[/p][/*][/list][p]- jounitus[/p]

notes.title: Demo Updated (v1004)
notes.notes: [p]Hello![/p][p][/p][p]New demo update (v1004). Most of these are thanks to the feedback on the demo. Thanks for sending all the feedback so far![/p][p][/p][p]Fixes:[/p][list][*][p]Show "tips" screen on the upgrades menu and show tips on the "run finished" screen[/p][/*][*][p]For "overcrowding" show the excess amount of blobs[/p][/*][*][p]Show "overcrowding passed" visual indication when the player beats the overcrowding[/p][/*][*][p]Hide overcrowded texts from the screen when the run is finished and also on boss levels[/p][/*][*][p]Small dialogue tweaks[/p][/*][*][p]Add an "automatic" checkbox to the level view to enable the automatic mouse movement[/p][/*][*][p]Add "grab mouse" option to the settings dialog to confine the mouse to the window[/p][/*][*][p]Don't show the back button on the run finished screen, since it doesn't do anything there[/p][/*][*][p]Show the level damage progress bar below the biome progress bar to better show individual level progress and to better indicate that damage makes the levels progress[/p][/*][*][p]Fix transition screen bug when buttons are double-clicked[/p][/*][*][p]Lower the "kill 30000 enemies" target to "kill 10000 enemies" to make it easier to gain currency at the start[/p][/*][*][p]Remove "collectible outfits" as an upgrade and make it on by default since the start of the game to get the passive income upgrade faster[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]- jounitus[/p]

notes.title: Demo Updated (v1003)
notes.notes: [p]New update was released (v1003)![/p][list][*][p]rename "Double Size" item to "Double Damage", make it change the size of the fingers and do more damage[/p][/*][*][p]reorganized upgrade nodes so that there are more interesting update at the start of the game[/p][/*][*][p]make early achievements easier to get[/p][/*][*][p]add "boss health divisor" upgrade to scale down boss health[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks to everyone who has given feedback and played the demo so far, these updates are related to those feedbacks, but there is more to come![/p][p][/p][p]- jouni[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Demo Updated (v1001)
notes.notes: [p]Quick update  (v1001) to address the "playerfollowers" error reported by players.[/p][list][*][p]Hopefully fixed the "playerfollowers" error[/p][/*][*][p]Added Steam cloud save support[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]- jounitus[/p]

notes.title: Finger Party Demo Released!
notes.notes: [p]Great news![/p][p][/p][p]The Finger Party demo was just released.[/p][p][/p][p]Very happy to be at this point where everyone can try out the game, after working on it for quite a long time.[/p][p][/p][p]The demo has the same full content as the eventual full release will have, in addition to upcoming balance tweaks, polishing and some new features.[/p][p][/p][p]The goal now is to try to get some feedback about the demo from the smaller audience first, before trying to push it to the wider audience.[/p][p][/p][p]Please try out the demo and remember to give honest feedback (there is a button inside the game to give feedback, you can also give feedback here on Steam)![/p][p][/p][p]Thanks![/p][p][/p][p]- jounitus[/p]

notes.title: Finger Party Announced!
notes.notes:
Hello!

New game announced: Finger Party!

Not to spoil the secrets of the Finger Party too much by blabbing about them here, please check the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3430630/Finger_Party/]Steam page for Finger Party[/url]!

I'm happy that the game has most of the components I want it to have, but there is still room for more content, balancing, general improvements and making things feel extra juicy!

There might be a demo coming up for the next Steam Next Fest on February 24th (2025), which I hope everyone will check out, if I'll get it out on time.

The game has progressed quite a lot during the last months from the early prototypes, since I've had some sort of internal timetable to release it at some point.

I'm also happy that there is now something to follow my previous game: "[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1613580/ARRIVAL_ZERO_EARTH/]Arrival: Zero Earth[/url]"!

More news to come!

Please [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3430630/Finger_Party/]wishlist Finger Party[/url] here on Steam to hear about future updates and when the game is finally released.

Thanks!

- jounitus
